newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Pioneer Hi-Bred raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Pioneer Hi-Bred raised to buy.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth Inc said Thursday it raised its rating on Pioneer Hi-Bred International Inc to buy from hold.
-- It said the company, as a provider of breeding material, could benefit from any major alliance in the seed industry.

-- Dain Bosworth also said in a report it does not view Pioneer as a takeover target though "talk continues in the industry about more potential consolidation, which tends to increase prices of the publicly traded seed companies."
-- Dain's earnings per share estimates on Pioneer are for $3.10 in 1997 and $3.60 in 1998. Its 12-month price target is $75. Pioneer was trading up 1/4 at 63-3/8.
